description: Holds grade designation mapping records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to job designation, job grade.
business_purpose: Used to track and report grade designation mapping records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one grade designation mapping.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the grade designation mapping.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the grade designation mapping.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: job_designationId
columns.description: Reference to the job designation linked to this grade designation mapping.

columns.name: job_gradeId
columns.description: Reference to the job grade linked to this grade designation mapping.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the grade designation mapping.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

relationships.description: User who created the grade designation mapping.
Each grade designation mapping references one job designation (job designation).
Each grade designation mapping references one job grade (job grade).
User who last modified the grade designation mapping.

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Join to Job Designation, Job Grade through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
GradeDesignationMapping is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.
common_queries: Grade Designation Mapping by job designation
Grade Designation Mapping by job grade

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against GradeDesignationMapping: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting grade designation mapping records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: job_designationId = JobDesignation.Id; job_gradeId = JobGrade.Id.
